usage: deskops add step [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                        [--title TITLE] [--action ACTION] [--outcome OUTCOME]
                        [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]]

Create a step artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the step payload from a YAML file.
  --title TITLE         Short step title.
  --action ACTION       What the step should do.
  --outcome OUTCOME     What the step should produce or confirm.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Semantic tags placed at the end, using namespaced forms such as 'topic:testing' or 'workspace:desk'.

Example:
  deskops add step --root . --title "Example"
